title: Great if you like what they send
text:
This was fun for a few months, but they should consider customizing your subscriptions a little more. I don’t need more products for frizzy hair, nor do I need any more bright red lipsticks or black eye makeup. And why is it that when they send cologne, its always the heavy, cloying scents—never the lighter, fresh scents that wouldnt’ gag you after trying it on your wrist? I really like getting new make-up to try, but there are way too many dark reds or nude lipsticks, and every eye makeup is always black. And for some reason, whenever they send hair products its for frizzy hair.
However every now and then they will send something really innovative—a dry shampoo, or a self-tanner, something you would always prefer to try before buying!! I will stick with them for a few more months and see if they make adjustments, but it seems like lately there are just a ton of mediocre face creams and mini hair products.
label: neutral
